result.summary: Found 2 issues: truncated restaurant name text in the Fastest near you carousel, and a missing/empty frameReference list as no other layout breakage is present beyond allowed horizontal clipping.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word (likely 'Piccolo'), making the name unreadable even though enough card width appears available.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant names wrap to two lines, use ellipsis with full name on tap, or give cards consistent width so full titles fit without truncation.

issues.description: Category filter chips row shows a partial empty chip on the far right with no label, which can look like a broken or unfinished control.
issues.suggestion: Hide overflow chips cleanly, add fade/scroll affordance, or ensure only fully rendered chips are visible at the edge.
